# `get`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns element of array at given (0-based) index. If the index points
outside of the array boundaries, then this function returns NULL.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
get(array, index)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `array_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- get, example 1
> SELECT get(array(1, 2, 3), 0);
1
```

```sql
-- get, example 2
> SELECT get(array(1, 2, 3), 3);
NULL
```

```sql
-- get, example 3
> SELECT get(array(1, 2, 3), -1);
NULL
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.4.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
